stories.headline: DeepSeek Eyes $12B Funding Round Backed by Tencent
stories.blurb: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek is in talks to raise at least $12 billion in a new funding round backed by tech giant Tencent, signaling massive ongoing capital injection into alternative frontier models.

stories.headline: Mistral AI Launches Flagship Mistral Large 4
stories.blurb: Mistral AI has released its latest flagship model, Mistral Large 4, designed to offer state-of-the-art multilingual reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities for enterprise workloads.

stories.headline: Reflection Debuts Giant 501B Open-Weight Model
stories.blurb: Reflection has introduced Beam, an enormous 501-billion-parameter open-weight model that pushes the boundaries of performance and scale available to the open-source community.

stories.headline: Utah Approves First Fully Autonomous AI Prescriptions
stories.blurb: In a first-of-its-kind regulatory pilot, Nolla Health will use autonomous AI to diagnose skin conditions and prescribe acne medications to patients in Utah without direct human oversight.

stories.headline: Hackers Acquire Counterfeit TLS Certificates for Google
stories.blurb: Security researchers warn that attackers have successfully obtained counterfeit TLS certificates for high-profile domains, including Google, threatening the underlying trust of web encryption.

stories.headline: Researcher Claims Guest-Host Escape in KVM
stories.blurb: A security researcher has claimed to find a critical guest-host escape vulnerability in Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM), a flaw that could allow malicious virtual machines to compromise the physical host.

stories.headline: Structural MCP Flaw Exposes Vulnerabilities in AI Agents
stories.blurb: A newly discovered vulnerability in agents from Google and others exposes a structural design flaw in Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP), potentially letting agents execute unauthorized local commands.

stories.headline: Critical Pre-Auth Path Traversal Flaw Disclosed in Atlassian Jira and Confluence
stories.blurb: Security researchers have detailed CVE-2026-21589, a severe pre-authentication path traversal vulnerability in Atlassian products that allows remote attackers to read arbitrary system files.

stories.headline: Software Supply Chain Attack Hits @subql/common
stories.blurb: A malicious update targeting the `@subql/common` npm package highlights the ongoing threat of dependency-injection software supply chain attacks on modern development workflows.

stories.headline: Python Polars Officially Releases Version 2.0.0
stories.blurb: The ultra-fast Polars dataframe library has reached its 2.0.0 milestone, introducing critical API refinements, major performance upgrades, and long-term stability for data engineering pipelines.

stories.headline: Mold 3.0 Linker Debuts with Key Performance Updates
stories.blurb: The highly efficient system linker `mold` has released version 3.0.0, bringing crucial compatibility improvements and faster link times to developer compilation loops.

stories.headline: Mitchell Hashimoto Proposes OSC 7501 Protocol for Terminal Status
stories.blurb: A new terminal protocol proposal (OSC 7501) aims to provide command-line applications with a standardized mechanism for communicating internal execution states to terminal emulators.
